A '''data uplink''' was a device in use during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] outfitted his [[Gauntlet/Legends|wrist gauntlets]] with a data uplink feature.
